all: I told chat I’d do an onion-themed stream… they said, ‘Shallot?’
I tried to make an onion laugh… but it was already in tiers.
My onion cosplay was too realistic… it brought the whole lobby to tears.
Why did the onion become a streamer? Because it had appeal.
Chat said ‘touch grass’… I said ‘I’m an onion. I am produce.’
I used to hate facial hair… but then it grew on me.
I’m reading a book about anti-gravity. It’s impossible to put down.
I would tell you a construction joke… but I’m still working on it.
Why don’t eggs tell jokes? They’d crack each other up.
I’m on a seafood diet. I see food and I eat it.
What do you call fake spaghetti? An impasta.
I only know 25 letters of the alphabet. I don’t know y.
I asked the dog what’s two minus two… he said nothing.
Did you hear about the restaurant on the moon? Great food, no atmosphere.
I told my suitcase there’d be no vacation this year… now it’s dealing with emotional baggage.
